mapper.select: select * from tb_wx_transfer_log where order_number = #{orderNumber} and deleted = 0 limit 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_wx_transfer_log( id, order_number, transfer_bill_no, state, mch_id, transfer_amount, openid, content, create_time, update_time, deleted ) VALUES ( null, #{orderNumber}, #{transferBillNo}, #{state}, #{mchId}, #{transferAmount}, #{openid}, #{content}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, 0 )
